path_map.mechanism: Invoke unchanged builder with the exact source tuple, target, service recipe, suite, output and plan paths. The caller does not manually call request-test or repeat a printed request line.
Derive D66_* SHA/TREE/CHECKOUT environment and node command from serviceRecipe; validate the explicit helper if present.
Build preflight and normal rows from the same recipe, refuse duplicate suite names or concurrent registry changes, then append exactly two rows atomically while preserving prior bytes.

Persist one submit artifact containing pins, checkouts, target, suites, recipes, and IDs. Existing artifact with normal ID is adopted and returned; existing preflight-only artifact waits the recorded preflight then requests one normal ID.

withSubmitLock plus artifactPath.lock serializes same-path submit work; lock records PID, waits on a live owner, and only removes a stale lock when PID is not alive. This is not permission for an independent manual normal request.

Builder calls request-test for preflight, waits for terminal pass, then calls request-test once for normal. request-test writes a durable request file/result directory, status=queued, and a pending queue item; the central dispatcher owns admission.
path_map.proof: source-only plus retained result artifacts; not re-run

path_map.mechanism: wait-test polls durable status and emits summary/exit only after terminal status; a pass receipt can credit the original body. A cancelled or unknown body is not a functional verdict.
